# ⭐Workflow overview

This workflow preprocesses the GSE196696 EPIC/850K whole-blood methylation dataset and applies an additional background-tissue filter to candidate hypo-DMRs that have passed independent validation and filtering against other normal tissues.

The whole-blood filtering criteria are:

- at least six CpG probes available within the DMR;
- minimum whole-blood group mean beta above 0.20.

All serialized R objects are saved as `.Rdata` files in the current analysis directory. CSV result tables, figures, and final checking tables are saved in the dedicated output folder:

##🍁🍁 dataset GSE196696 EPIC methylation data preprocessing
In this step, we performed three main tasks for the dataset:
1.Created a standardized beta-value matrix.
2.Constructed a Normal/Tumor phenotype table and aligned the phenotype information with the corresponding samples in the beta-value matrix.
3.Applied champ.filter() for quality control and probe filtering, and saved the resulting myLoad object, which contains the filtered beta-value matrix and its corresponding phenotype table.


## 🍁🍁 Step 3.1: Whole-blood background filtering

Here, we mainly use the GSE196696 whole-blood methylation dataset to further evaluate the background methylation levels of candidate hypo-DMRs.

Step 1:Identify the EPIC CpG probes located within each candidate DMR.

Step 2:Calculate the regional beta value for each DMR across all whole-blood samples.

Step 3: Retain DMRs containing at least six CpGs and showing a minimum whole-blood group mean beta above 0.20.

Step 4:Save the retained DMRs, removed DMRs, summary tables, figures, and quality-checking results for downstream analysis.

#### set input and output files
```{r set_input_and_output_files}
## Candidate DMR table generated by the previous filtering step
candidate_dmr_input <- "background_filtered_hypo_DMRs_beta_gt_0.2_nCpG_gt5.csv"

outdir <- file.path(".","step3.1.background filtering in WBC hypo")
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) {dir.create(outdir,recursive = TRUE)}

```


#### Set filtering parameters

```{r set-whole-blood-filtering-parameters}
beta_threshold <- 0.20

## nCpG > 5 is equivalent to requiring at least six CpGs.
min_bg_cpg <- 6

dataset_name <- "GSE196696"

```

#### Load candidate DMRs

```{r load-candidate-dmrs}
candidate_dmrs <- fread(
  candidate_dmr_input,
  data.table = FALSE)
print(dim(candidate_dmrs))

print(head(candidate_dmrs))

stopifnot(all(c("DMR_ID",
      "chr",
      "start",
      "end") %in% colnames(candidate_dmrs)),
  anyDuplicated(candidate_dmrs$DMR_ID) == 0)

nrow(candidate_dmrs)
```

#### Standardize chromosome labels

```{r define-chromosome-standardization-function}
fix_chr <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  x <- gsub(
    "^chr",
    "",
    x,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  x[x == "23"] <- "X"
  x[x == "24"] <- "Y"
  x[x %in% c("M", "MT")] <- "M"

  paste0("chr", x)
}
```

#### Clean candidate DMR coordinates

```{r clean-candidate-dmr-coordinates}
n_dmrs_before_coordinate_filter <- nrow(
  candidate_dmrs
)

candidate_dmrs$chr <- fix_chr(
  candidate_dmrs$chr
)

candidate_dmrs$start <- as.numeric(
  candidate_dmrs$start
)

candidate_dmrs$end <- as.numeric(
  candidate_dmrs$end
)

candidate_dmrs <- candidate_dmrs[
  !is.na(candidate_dmrs$chr) &
    !is.na(candidate_dmrs$start) &
    !is.na(candidate_dmrs$end) &
    candidate_dmrs$start <= candidate_dmrs$end,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

candidate_dmrs <- candidate_dmrs[
  candidate_dmrs$chr %in% paste0("chr", 1:22),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat("DMRs before coordinate filtering:",
    n_dmrs_before_coordinate_filter, "\n")

cat("DMRs after coordinate filtering:",
    nrow(candidate_dmrs))

if (nrow(candidate_dmrs) == 0) {
  stop("No candidate DMRs remained after coordinate filtering.")
}

stopifnot(anyDuplicated(candidate_dmrs$DMR_ID) == 0)
```

#### Construct DMR genomic ranges

```{r build-candidate-dmr-ranges}
dmr_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = candidate_dmrs$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = candidate_dmrs$start,
    end = candidate_dmrs$end),
  DMR_ID = candidate_dmrs$DMR_ID)

stopifnot(length(dmr_gr) == nrow(candidate_dmrs))
```

#### Load the ChAMP-filtered whole-blood object

```{r load-gse196696-champ-object}

load("step0.3-GSE196696_output.Rdata")

myLoad_GSE196696 <- myLoad

beta_bg <- as.matrix(myLoad_GSE196696$beta)

storage.mode(beta_bg) <- "numeric"

pd_bg <- as.data.frame(myLoad_GSE196696$pd)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(beta_bg),rownames(pd_bg)))

pd_bg$group <- as.character(pd_bg$group)

#### Build sample mapping table

sample_mapping_GSE196696 <- data.frame(
  GSM = colnames(beta_bg),
  group = pd_bg$group,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rownames(sample_mapping_GSE196696) <-
  sample_mapping_GSE196696$GSM

stopifnot(
  identical(
    sample_mapping_GSE196696$GSM,
    colnames(beta_bg)
  )
)

print(dim(sample_mapping_GSE196696))
head(sample_mapping_GSE196696)
table(sample_mapping_GSE196696$group)

print(dim(beta_bg))

print(dim(beta_bg))

print(dim(pd_bg))

print(table(pd_bg$group, useNA = "ifany"))
```

#### Load and clean the EPIC annotation

```{r load-epic-annotation}
anno <- minfi::getAnnotation(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICanno.ilm10b4.hg19)

anno <- as.data.frame(anno)
anno$CpG <- rownames(anno)
anno$chr <- fix_chr(anno$chr)
anno$pos <- as.numeric(anno$pos)

anno <- anno[
  !is.na(anno$CpG) &
    !is.na(anno$chr) &
    !is.na(anno$pos) &
    anno$chr %in% paste0("chr", 1:22),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (anyDuplicated(anno$CpG) > 0) {
  stop("Duplicated CpG probe IDs were found in the EPIC annotation.")
}

print(dim(anno))
```

#### Align annotation with available beta probes

```{r align-annotation-with-beta-probes}
common_cpgs <- intersect(rownames(beta_bg),anno$CpG)

if (length(common_cpgs) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No common CpG probes were found between ",
      "the beta matrix and EPIC annotation."))}

beta_bg <- beta_bg[
  common_cpgs,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

anno <- anno[
  match(
    common_cpgs,
    anno$CpG
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(beta_bg),anno$CpG))

print(length(common_cpgs))
```

#### Construct CpG genomic ranges

```{r build-epic-cpg-ranges}
cpg_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = anno$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = anno$pos,
    end = anno$pos
  ),
  CpG = anno$CpG
)

stopifnot(length(cpg_gr) == nrow(anno))
```

#### Map CpGs to candidate DMRs

```{r map-cpgs-to-candidate-dmrs}
hits <- findOverlaps(
  dmr_gr,
  cpg_gr
)

length(hits)

dmr_cpg_list <- split(
  mcols(cpg_gr)$CpG[
    subjectHits(hits)
  ],
  queryHits(hits)
)

dmr_annotation_cpg_counts <- integer(
  nrow(candidate_dmrs)
)

if (length(dmr_cpg_list) > 0) {
  mapped_indices <- as.integer(
    names(dmr_cpg_list)
  )

  dmr_annotation_cpg_counts[
    mapped_indices
  ] <- lengths(dmr_cpg_list)
}

print(summary(dmr_annotation_cpg_counts))
print(sum(dmr_annotation_cpg_counts == 0))
```

#### Define safe summary functions

```{r define-safe-summary-functions}
safe_mean <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

safe_median <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  median(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
safe_min <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  min(
    x,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  as.numeric(
    quantile(
      x,
      probs = probability,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )
  )
}

safe_proportion_above <- function(x, threshold) {
  if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(
    x > threshold,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
}
```

#### Initialize whole-blood result objects

```{r initialize-whole-blood-results}
dmr_beta_GSE196696 <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(candidate_dmrs),
  ncol = ncol(beta_bg),
  dimnames = list(
    candidate_dmrs$DMR_ID,
    colnames(beta_bg)
  )
)

background_results_GSE196696 <- candidate_dmrs

background_results_GSE196696$nCpG_GSE196696 <- 0L
background_results_GSE196696$meanBeta_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$medianBeta_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$maxSampleBeta_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$p95Beta_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$min_group_mean_beta_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$propSamples_beta_gt_0.20_GSE196696 <- NA_real_
background_results_GSE196696$GSE196696_pass <- FALSE
```

#### Calculate DMR-level whole-blood beta values

```{r calculate-whole-blood-dmr-beta}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(candidate_dmrs))) {

  cpgs <- dmr_cpg_list[[as.character(i)]]

  if (is.null(cpgs)) {
    next
  }

  cpgs <- unique(
    intersect(
      cpgs,
      rownames(beta_bg)
    )
  )

  n_cpgs <- length(cpgs)

  background_results_GSE196696$
    nCpG_GSE196696[i] <- n_cpgs

  if (n_cpgs == 0) {
    next
  }

  ## Calculate one regional mean beta value for each sample.
  dmr_value <- colMeans(
    beta_bg[
      cpgs,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  dmr_value[
    is.nan(dmr_value)
  ] <- NA_real_

  dmr_beta_GSE196696[
    i,
  ] <- dmr_value

  ## GSE196696 contains one background group: Whole_blood.
  group_mean <- tapply(
  dmr_value,
  pd_bg$group,
  safe_mean
)

min_group_mean_beta <- safe_min(
  group_mean
)

  background_results_GSE196696$
    meanBeta_GSE196696[i] <- safe_mean(
      dmr_value
    )

  background_results_GSE196696$
    medianBeta_GSE196696[i] <- safe_median(
      dmr_value
    )

  background_results_GSE196696$
    maxSampleBeta_GSE196696[i] <- safe_max(
      dmr_value
    )

  background_results_GSE196696$
    p95Beta_GSE196696[i] <- safe_quantile(
      dmr_value,
      probability = 0.95
    )

  background_results_GSE196696$
  min_group_mean_beta_GSE196696[i] <-
  min_group_mean_beta

  background_results_GSE196696$
    propSamples_beta_gt_0.20_GSE196696[i] <-
    safe_proportion_above(
      dmr_value,
      threshold = beta_threshold
    )

  ## A hypo-DMR passes when it has at least six CpGs and
## its minimum whole-blood group mean beta is above 0.20.
background_results_GSE196696$
  GSE196696_pass[i] <-
  n_cpgs >= min_bg_cpg &&
  !is.na(min_group_mean_beta) &&
  min_group_mean_beta > beta_threshold
}
```

#### Separate retained and removed DMRs

```{r split-retained-and-removed-dmrs}
final_dmrs_after_GSE196696 <- background_results_GSE196696[
  background_results_GSE196696$GSE196696_pass %in% TRUE,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

removed_dmrs_by_GSE196696 <- background_results_GSE196696[
  !background_results_GSE196696$GSE196696_pass %in% TRUE,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

cat("Final retained DMRs:\n")
print(dim(final_dmrs_after_GSE196696))

cat("\nRemoved DMRs:\n")
print(dim(removed_dmrs_by_GSE196696))
```

#### Build the filtering summary

```{r summarize-whole-blood-filtering}
background_summary_GSE196696 <- data.frame(
  dataset = dataset_name,

  Input_DMRs = nrow(
    background_results_GSE196696
  ),

  DMRs_with_CpG_overlap = sum(
    background_results_GSE196696$
      nCpG_GSE196696 > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  DMRs_with_nCpG_gt5 = sum(
    background_results_GSE196696$
      nCpG_GSE196696 >= min_bg_cpg,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),

  DMRs_with_meanBeta_gt_0.20 = sum(
  background_results_GSE196696$
    min_group_mean_beta_GSE196696 >
    beta_threshold,
  na.rm = TRUE
),

  Final_passed_DMRs = nrow(
    final_dmrs_after_GSE196696
  ),

  Final_retained_percent = round(
    100 *
      nrow(final_dmrs_after_GSE196696) /
      nrow(background_results_GSE196696),
    2
  ),

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print(
  background_summary_GSE196696,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

#### Save CSV result tables

```{r save-whole-blood-csv-results}
fwrite(

)

fwrite(

fwrite(

fwrite(

  )
)

cat("\nCSV result tables were saved in:\n")

print(

    mustWork = FALSE

)
```

```{r save-whole-blood-rdata}
  beta_bg = beta_bg,
  pd_bg = pd_bg,
  dmr_cpg_list = dmr_cpg_list,
  dmr_annotation_cpg_counts = dmr_annotation_cpg_counts,
  dmr_beta_GSE196696 = dmr_beta_GSE196696,
  background_results_GSE196696 = background_results_GSE196696,
  final_dmrs_after_GSE196696 = final_dmrs_after_GSE196696,
  removed_dmrs_by_GSE196696 = removed_dmrs_by_GSE196696,
  background_summary_GSE196696 = background_summary_GSE196696,
  beta_threshold = beta_threshold,
  min_bg_cpg = min_bg_cpg,

save(

  file = file.path(
```

## 🍁🍁 Visualisation

#### Prepare plotting data

```{r prepare-whole-blood-plotting-data}
plot_df <- background_results_GSE196696

plot_df$Pass_status <- ifelse(
  plot_df$GSE196696_pass %in% TRUE,
  "Passed",
  "Not passed"
)

plot_df$Pass_status <- factor(
  plot_df$Pass_status,
  levels = c(
    "Passed",
    "Not passed"
  )
)
```

#### Figure 1: Filtering flow

```{r build-filtering-flow-plot}
library(ggplot2)
flow_df <- data.frame(
  Step = factor(
    c(
      "Input DMRs",
"CpG overlap",
"nCpG ≥ 6",
"nCpG ≥ 6 + beta > 0.20"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "Input DMRs",
"CpG overlap",
"nCpG ≥ 6",
"nCpG ≥ 6 + beta > 0.20"
    )
  ),

  Count = c(
    nrow(background_results_GSE196696),

    sum(
      background_results_GSE196696$nCpG_GSE196696 > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    sum(
      background_results_GSE196696$nCpG_GSE196696 >= min_bg_cpg,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    nrow(final_dmrs_after_GSE196696)
  )
)

p_flow <- ggplot(
  flow_df,
  aes(
    x = Step,
    y = Count
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    width = 0.65,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    vjust = -0.4,
    size = 4
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE196696 whole-blood background filtering",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of DMRs"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(
      0,
      max(flow_df$Count) * 1.15
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 30,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

print(p_flow)
```

## Save Figure 1

```{r save-filtering-flow-plot}
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(
    outdir,
    "GSE196696_whole_blood_background_filtering_flow.png"
  ),
  plot = p_flow,
  width = 7,
  height = 4.8,

)
```

#### Figure 2: Whole-blood beta distribution

```{r build-whole-blood-beta-distribution}
p_beta <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = min_group_mean_beta_GSE196696
  )
) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40,
    fill = "grey70",
    color = "black",
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = beta_threshold,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE196696 whole-blood background methylation",
    x = "Minimum group mean beta in whole blood",
    y = "Number of DMRs"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

print(p_beta)
```

```{r save-whole-blood-beta-distribution}
ggsave(
```

## Figure 3: CpG coverage versus whole-blood beta

```{r build-cpg-beta-scatter-plot}
p_scatter <- ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = nCpG_GSE196696,
    y = min_group_mean_beta_GSE196696,
    shape = Pass_status
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = beta_threshold,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = min_bg_cpg,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  labs(
    title = "CpG coverage and whole-blood methylation in GSE196696",
    x = "Number of overlapping CpGs",
    y = "Minimum group mean beta in whole blood",
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

print(p_scatter)
```
